description: I'm a graduate student interested in design, for the planet and space. Martian Wayfinder is my proposed solution: a digital navigation and mission-planning companion designed specifically for astronauts exploring Mars, a combination of Google Maps, a scientific field guide, and a personal safety assistant, all designed for the unique challenges of exploring another planet. My goal is simple: To help future Mars explorers spend less time figuring out how to navigate, more time making discoveries.
